notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: this week s Steam new release highlights
notes.content:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly round-up of the best new but under-reported games released on Steam over the past seven days.

This week: SF startup simulation, nihilistic Tetris, toilet humour and fantasy RPG Tinder.
(more…)

notes.title: Supermagical is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello there!

If you haven't had the chance to try out one of the best puzzle/RPG games of mobile platforms, at last here's your chance!
This is a 1080p/60fps version of Supermagical with lots of retouches and a remastered original soundtrack that you even get for free for a limited time.
Kind of a bargain, I'd say!

Sit back and relax while you explore the Magic World and all its secrets that we made for you.

Enjoy the game and thank you very much for your support!
-Super Awesome Hyper Dimensional Mega Team
